description:
One belief per theme, every one created above 0.45, every evidence record at source-default weights.

No channel applies, so the required outcome is EXACTLY zero divergences and a single flag ends stage 0. This is the only thing standing between the detector and a base rate: the prose loss rate on a real web is 0.727-0.971 (pre-registration section 1.2), so a detector that flags on non-appearance alone looks productive on every other fixture here.

It is also built so as not to be trivially clean. One belief per theme means prose loss is exactly 0.0, so a zero is the detector agreeing with an honest web rather than an artefact of a web with nothing in it.

expect.note: Structural properties, checkable by reading the file. No expected detector output appears anywhere in this fixture; requirements section 7.
